checkout_card_amount_check.name: checkout_card_amount_check
checkout_card_amount_check.value: "checkout_card_attempts"."subtotal_cents" >= 0 AND "checkout_card_attempts"."tax_cents" >= 0 AND "checkout_card_attempts"."tip_cents" >= 0 AND "checkout_card_attempts"."total_cents" = "checkout_card_attempts"."subtotal_cents"+"checkout_card_attempts"."tax_cents"+"checkout_card_attempts"."tip_cents" AND "checkout_card_attempts"."total_cents" BETWEEN 1 AND 100000000

payments_manual_confirmation_audit_check.name: payments_manual_confirmation_audit_check
payments_manual_confirmation_audit_check.value: "payments"."confirmation_method" IS DISTINCT FROM 'MANUAL' OR ("payments"."confirmed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL)

account_creation_state_check.name: account_creation_state_check
account_creation_state_check.value: ("twilio_account_creation_intents"."status" = 'INTENT' AND "twilio_account_creation_intents"."twilio_account_id" IS NULL AND "twilio_account_creation_intents"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("twilio_account_creation_intents"."status" = 'COMPLETED' AND "twilio_account_creation_intents"."twilio_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "twilio_account_creation_intents"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

twilio_provision_operations_review_check.name: twilio_provision_operations_review_check
twilio_provision_operations_review_check.value: ("twilio_provision_operations"."reviewed_at" IS NULL AND "twilio_provision_operations"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "twilio_provision_operations"."review_reference" IS NULL) OR ("twilio_provision_operations"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "twilio_provision_operations"."reviewed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "twilio_provision_operations"."review_reference" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("twilio_provision_operations"."review_reference")) > 0 AND "twilio_provision_operations"."status" = 'COMPLETED')
